points.title: 童年启蒙
points.description: 孔子出生于鲁国陬邑（今山东曲阜），幼年丧父，家境贫寒。他自幼好学，常向长辈请教礼乐知识。据《史记》记载，孔子年少时即好礼，常陈俎豆，设礼容。这一时期奠定了他对古代典籍和礼仪文化的浓厚兴趣，为他后来的思想体系奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Zouyi (modern Qufu, Shandong) in the State of Lu, Confucius lost his father at a young age and grew up in poverty. Despite these circumstances, he displayed a strong passion for learning, frequently seeking guidance from elders about ritual and music. According to historical records, even as a child, he was fascinated by rites and ceremonies, often arranging ritual vessels and practicing ceremonial postures. This early period laid the foundation for his deep interest in ancient classics and ritual culture, which would later form the basis of his philosophical system.

points.placeEn: Qufu, Capital of State of Lu
points.title: 求学与教学
points.description: 青年时期的孔子广泛学习，师从多位名师，掌握了六艺（礼、乐、射、御、书、数）。他开始收徒授业，打破了贵族垄断教育的局面。这一时期，孔子系统研究了古代典籍，尤其是《诗》《书》《礼》《乐》等，形成了自己的教育理念。他提出'有教无类'的思想，主张教育应当不分贵贱，为平民子弟提供了接受教育的机会。
points.descriptionEn: During his youth, Confucius studied extensively under multiple masters, mastering the Six Arts (rites, music, archery, chariot-driving, calligraphy, and mathematics). He began taking on students, breaking the monopoly on education previously held by the aristocracy. During this period, he systematically studied ancient classics, particularly the 'Book of Odes', 'Book of Documents', 'Book of Rites', and 'Book of Music', forming his own educational philosophy. He proposed the idea of 'education without class distinction', advocating that education should be accessible regardless of social status, thereby providing opportunities for commoners to receive education.

points.title: 从政与周游
points.description: 孔子在鲁国担任中都宰、司空、大司寇等职，政治才能得到施展。他推行'堕三都'政策，削弱三家大夫势力，加强公室权力。后因政治理念不合，离开鲁国，开始长达14年的周游列国。先后到卫、陈、蔡、楚等国，宣传自己的政治主张和教育理念。这一时期，孔子虽屡遭挫折，但始终坚持自己的理想，形成了'知其不可而为之'的处世态度。
points.descriptionEn: Confucius held various positions in the State of Lu, including Governor of Zhongdu, Minister of Works, and Minister of Justice, where he could施展 his political talents. He implemented the policy of 'demolishing the three fortified cities' to weaken the power of the three powerful ministers and strengthen the authority of the duke. Later due to political disagreements, he left Lu and began a 14-year journey through various states, including Wei, Chen, Cai, and Chu, promoting his political philosophy and educational ideals. During this period, despite numerous setbacks, Confucius remained steadfast in his ideals, developing his attitude of 'knowing it is impossible yet still doing it'.

points.placeEn: States of Wei, Chen, Cai, and others
points.title: 颠沛流离
points.description: 周游列国期间，孔子虽受到各国君主的礼遇，但政治主张始终未被采纳。在卫国，他曾见卫灵公，但未被重用；在陈蔡之间，甚至遭遇围困，断粮七日，'君子固穷'的信念使他处之泰然。这一时期，孔子虽生活困顿，但思想更加成熟，整理了大量古代典籍，并继续收徒授业。他的弟子们如颜回、子路等始终追随左右，形成了儒家学派的核心群体。
points.descriptionEn: During his travels, although Confucius received courtesy from rulers of various states, his political proposals were never adopted. In Wei, he met Duke Ling but was not given an important position; between Chen and Cai, he was even besieged and went without food for seven days. Yet his belief that 'a gentleman can endure poverty' allowed him to remain calm. During this period of hardship, Confucius' thoughts matured further, he organized numerous ancient classics, and continued teaching. His disciples such as Yan Hui and Zilu remained loyal to him, forming the core group of what would become the Confucian school.

points.title: 晚年归鲁与著述
points.titleEn: Return to Lu in Later Years and Writings
points.description: 68岁时，孔子回到鲁国，专心整理古代典籍，教授弟子。他晚年致力于《春秋》的编纂，通过微言大义表达自己的政治立场和价值观。同时，他系统整理了《诗》《书》《礼》《乐》《易》《春秋》等典籍，奠定了儒家经典的基础。这一时期，孔子的思想体系更加完善，弟子们将其言行记录整理，形成了《论语》的雏形。孔子于公元前479年去世，葬于曲阜城北的泗水河畔，弟子们为其守丧三年，体现了深厚的师生情谊和对师道的尊崇。
points.descriptionEn: At the age of 68, Confucius returned to Lu and dedicated himself to organizing ancient classics and teaching disciples. In his later years, he focused on compiling the 'Spring and Autumn Annals', expressing his political stance and values through subtle yet profound language. He systematically organized classics such as the 'Book of Odes', 'Book of Documents', 'Book of Rites', 'Book of Music', 'Book of Changes', and 'Spring and Autumn Annals', laying the foundation of Confucian classics. During this period, Confucius' philosophical system became more complete, and his disciples began recording his words and actions, forming the prototype of 'The Analects'. Confucius passed away in 479 BCE and was buried on the banks of the Si River north of Qufu. His disciples observed a three-year mourning period, reflecting their deep respect for their teacher and the importance of teacher-student relationships.

supporter.zh: 孔子被尊为'至圣先师'，是中国古代最伟大的思想家和教育家。他创立的儒家思想对中国乃至东亚文化产生了深远影响，塑造了中国人的价值观和行为准则。孔子提倡'仁爱'、'礼制'、'中庸'等理念，强调个人修养和社会和谐，为中国传统政治伦理奠定了基础。他的教育思想打破了贵族对知识的垄断，开创了平民教育的先河，对后世教育发展具有不可磨灭的贡献。
supporter.en: Confucius is revered as the 'Supreme Sage and First Teacher', China's greatest ancient thinker and educator. The Confucian philosophy he founded has profoundly influenced Chinese and East Asian culture, shaping Chinese values and codes of conduct. He promoted concepts such as 'benevolence', 'ritual propriety', and 'the golden mean', emphasizing personal cultivation and social harmony, laying the foundation for traditional Chinese political ethics. His educational thought broke the aristocracy's monopoly on knowledge, pioneering popular education and making indelible contributions to the development of education throughout history.

critic.zh: 孔子思想也受到诸多批评，尤其是被视为维护封建等级制度的工具。他的'君君臣臣父父子子'的伦理观念被认为强化了专制统治，限制了个人自由。'三纲五常'等思想被后世统治者利用，成为束缚人性的枷锁。此外，孔子对'女子难养'的言论被视为性别歧视，'唯女子与小人难养也'的观点也备受争议。在现代社会，其强调集体和谐而忽视个体权利的思想也受到质疑，被认为不利于创新和个人发展。
critic.en: Confucian thought has also faced criticism, particularly for being seen as a tool that maintained feudal hierarchy. His ethical concept of 'ruler should be ruler, subject should be subject, father should be father, son should be son' is believed to have reinforced autocratic rule and limited individual freedom. The 'Three Bonds and Five Constant Virtues' were later exploited by rulers to become shackles that constrained human nature. Additionally, his remarks about 'women are difficult to nurture' are considered sexist, and his view that 'only women and petty men are hard to nurture' has been controversial. In modern society, his emphasis on collective harmony over individual rights has also been questioned for potentially hindering innovation and personal development.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，孔子是中国古代文化的集大成者，他整理和传承了三代以来的文化精髓。他的思想体系既有保守性，也有进步性，既维护社会秩序，也强调道德自觉。在流行文化中，孔子形象经历了从'圣人'到'凡人'再到'文化符号'的转变，反映了不同时代对传统文化的态度。孔子思想作为中华文明的重要组成部分，不仅塑造了中国历史，也影响了东亚文化圈，成为世界文明史上的重要现象。他的教育理念和方法至今仍有借鉴意义，体现了超越时代的智慧。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Confucius was a great synthesizer of ancient Chinese culture, preserving and passing on the essence of cultural heritage from the Xia, Shang, and Zhou dynasties. His philosophical system contains both conservative and progressive elements, maintaining social order while emphasizing moral self-cultivation. In popular culture, the image of Confucius has transformed from 'saint' to 'ordinary person' to 'cultural symbol', reflecting changing attitudes toward traditional culture across different eras. As an essential part of Chinese civilization, Confucian thought has not only shaped Chinese history but also influenced the East Asian cultural sphere, becoming a significant phenomenon in world civilization history. His educational philosophy and methods still offer valuable insights today, demonstrating wisdom that transcends time.

self.zh: 学而时习之，不亦说乎？有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎？人不知而不愠，不亦君子乎？
self.en: Is it not a pleasure to learn and to practice what is learned from time to time? Is it not a delight to have friends coming from afar? Is it not a gentleman he who remains unperturbed when not appreciated by others?

others.zh: 天不生仲尼，万古如长夜。
others.en: If Heaven had not sent forth Confucius, the ages would have been like a long night.
